settings.name: OIDF_SSF_ISSUER
settings.description: The transmitter's issuer: the SETs' iss and the base of every endpoint it advertises, so the external base receivers use; unset, SSF is off (unless OIDF_SSF_ENABLED=true) and PingFederate starts regardless

when_wrong.detail: Unset: SSF is off (DISABLED). With OIDF_SSF_ENABLED=true it is FAILED_CONFIG, with an ERROR naming this setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_SIGNING_ALGORITHM
settings.description: How the transmitter signs its SETs

when_wrong.detail: Anything but RS256 or PS256 (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_DATA_STORE_ID
settings.description: A PingFederate JDBC data store, on PostgreSQL, whose pool the SSF store uses; with neither this nor a JDBC URL the store is in memory, lost at a restart and seen by one node only, which production allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted

when_wrong.detail: An unknown id, or its database down: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause. A database that is not PostgreSQL is refused in production (REFUSED)

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_STORE_DIALECT
settings.description: The SSF store's layout: tables, its own three ssf_ tables, or ldm, the Identity Object Model's entry store; only read with a data store or a JDBC URL

when_wrong.detail: Anything but tables or ldm (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_JDBC_URL
settings.description: A direct database for the SSF store, for development; wins over the data store. jdbc:h2: and jdbc:hsqldb: are refused, and in production anything but jdbc:postgresql:

when_wrong.detail: A database that cannot be opened: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause; the ERROR shows <jdbcUrl> for the URL. A URL that is not jdbc:postgresql: is refused in production (REFUSED)

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_JDBC_USERNAME
settings.description: The user for the direct database

when_wrong.detail: As the JDBC URL, the store does not open: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_JDBC_PASSWORD
settings.description: The password for the direct database

when_wrong.detail: As the JDBC URL, the store does not open: SSF is FAILED_DEPENDENCY, its endpoints answer 503, and the supervisor starts it again (a wait of up to 5 s doubling to 300 s), with an ERROR each time naming the cause

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether every SET is also published to Kafka; off, no Kafka class is loaded

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it; true without the bootstrap servers is FAILED_CONFIG too

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS
settings.description: The Kafka brokers, host:port comma-separated; required with Kafka on

when_wrong.detail: Unset with Kafka on: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_TOPIC
settings.description: The Kafka topic SETs are published to

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SECURITY_PROTOCOL
settings.description: Kafka's security.protocol: SSL (the default), SASL_SSL, or PLAINTEXT and SASL_PLAINTEXT, which send SETs (and a SASL password) in clear and which the production profile refuses

when_wrong.detail: Anything but SSL, SASL_SSL, PLAINTEXT or SASL_PLAINTEXT (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. PLAINTEXT or SASL_PLAINTEXT under the production profile: SSF is REFUSED, by the start-up sweep whether Kafka is on or not, and by KafkaSetPublisher again when Kafka starts, for a value that reached it another way (an init-param); under development each is used, with a WARN. A protocol the brokers do not speak: every publish fails and is logged, and the streams still get their SETs

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_MECHANISM
settings.description: Kafka's sasl.mechanism when the protocol is a SASL one; PLAIN when unset

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_USERNAME
settings.description: The SASL user for Kafka

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SASL_PASSWORD
settings.description: The SASL password for Kafka

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS
settings.description: How many failed pushes of one SET a push stream takes before it is paused as dead-lettered; 1 or less pauses it on the first failed push

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_PUSH_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS
settings.description: The background loop's tick, and the base of the push retry's doubling backoff; below 1 means 1

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_POLL_MAX_EVENTS
settings.description: The most SETs a poll answers when the receiver asks for no number, and the most the receiver's own poll asks for (100 when this is 0 or less)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_SET_TTL_SECONDS
settings.description: How long an undelivered SET is kept before it is deleted; 0 or less keeps it for ever

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_SCOPE
settings.description: The scope a bearer token needs for the stream management API and the poll

when_wrong.detail: A scope no client holds: every call is a 403

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_UNOWNED_STREAM_OWNER
settings.description: The one client admitted to streams that record no owner; unset, nobody is

when_wrong.detail: An id that names no client admits nobody

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_PROVISIONER_SCOPE
settings.description: The scope that admits a client to the SCIM endpoint and events:emit; unset, nobody is. Never the receiver scope

when_wrong.detail: The receiver scope: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming both settings

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_ALLOWED_AUDIENCES
settings.description: The aud values a client may name when it creates a stream besides its own id, as clientA=aud1,aud2;clientB=aud3

when_wrong.detail: An entry that is not clientId=aud[,aud]: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_ENDPOINT
settings.description: Where receivers' and provisioners' bearer tokens are introspected (RFC 7662), through platform's TokenIntrospector: 1 s to connect, 2.5 s in all, and no answer is a 503; <issuer>/as/introspect.oauth2 when unset. An active answer is also held to its exp and nbf, to aud containing OIDF_SSF_ISSUER when it carries an aud, and to carrying a client_id; a token bound to a key or certificate (cnf) is refused, because the SSF endpoints take bearer tokens only

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A URL that is not an introspection endpoint: every authenticated call is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The client that introspects receivers' tokens; unset, no receiver can authenticate

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: every authenticated call is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: The introspecting client's secret

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: every authenticated call is a 503

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INTROSPECTION_INSECURE_TLS
settings.description: Trusts any certificate on the introspection call, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_DEFAULT_EVENT_TYPES
settings.description: The event types the transmitter advertises as events_supported, comma-separated; the five CAEP and RISC types it emits when unset

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written, split at commas and blanks; set to nothing but separators: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_DEFAULT_SUBJECTS
settings.description: What a stream hears before any subject is added to it: NONE, or ALL, every subject (SSF 1.0 7.1.1)

when_wrong.detail: Anything but ALL or NONE (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_VERIFICATION_EVENT_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether a receiver may ask for a verification event

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_EXPECTED_ISSUER
settings.description: The transmitter whose SETs this PingFederate accepts; set, the receiver is on (unless OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ENABLED=false)

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: every SET is refused

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_JWKS_URL
settings.description: The JWKS inbound SETs are verified against; <receiverExpectedIssuer>/pf/JWKS when unset

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The wrong JWKS: every SET is refused

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_AUDIENCE
settings.description: The aud an inbound SET must carry; required with the receiver on

when_wrong.detail: Unset with the receiver on: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoint answers 503, with an ERROR naming it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ENDPOINT_AUTH_TOKEN
settings.description: The bearer token a transmitter must present to push to this receiver; required with the receiver on

when_wrong.detail: Unset with the receiver on: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoint answers 503, with an ERROR naming it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_JWKS_CACHE_SECONDS
settings.description: How long the receiver keeps the transmitter's JWKS; 0 or less fetches it for each SET

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_INSECURE_TLS
settings.description: Trusts any certificate on the receiver's JWKS fetch, poll and stream calls, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_URL
settings.description: A transmitter's poll endpoint to pull SETs from; unset, the receiver takes pushes only

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The wrong endpoint: each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_TOKEN
settings.description: A static bearer token for the receiver's poll and stream calls, for development only: it never expires or rotates, and the receiver cannot fetch a new one when the transmitter refuses it; production uses a client (OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT)

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: each poll fails and is logged. Set beside OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
settings.description: How often the receiver polls; below 1 means 1

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_ACTIONS_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether an inbound revocation signal acts on PingFederate, revoking the subject's grants

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_INSTANCE_REGISTRY
settings.description: Whether inbound CAEP signals act on the agent instance registry; needs the ldm store, and is refused with a warning on any other

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_AUDIT_EVENTS_ENABLED
settings.description: Whether PingFederate's security audit events are turned into SETs

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_AUDIT_EVENT_MAP
settings.description: EVENT=action pairs, comma-separated, that extend or override which audit events become which SETs

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT
settings.description: The transmitter's authorization server token endpoint, where the receiver gets its poll and stream token by client credentials

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host, or set without OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_ID and one of its secret or key: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The wrong endpoint: each poll fails and is logged, and a managed stream leaves SSF_RECEIVER FAILED_DEPENDENCY. An http URL under the production profile refuses SSF_RECEIVER: the client's credentials and the token it gets would cross the network in clear (RFC 6749 §3.2: the authorization server "MUST require the use of TLS" at the token endpoint)

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The receiver's client id at the transmitter's authorization server

when_wrong.detail: Set without OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. Wrong: the token endpoint refuses it, each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: The receiver client's secret, sent as client_secret_basic; set this or OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_KEY

when_wrong.detail: Set with OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_KEY, or without OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. Wrong: the token endpoint refuses it, each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_KEY
settings.description: The receiver client's private key as a JWK, signing a private_key_jwt assertion; set this or OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_SECRET

when_wrong.detail: Not a private RSA, EC or OKP JWK, set with OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_SECRET, or without OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A key the server does not know: each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_CLIENT_SCOPE
settings.description: The scope the receiver asks for with its client credentials; unset, it asks for none and takes the server's default

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: the token lacks what the transmitter asks for, each poll fails and is logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TRANSMITTER_CONFIGURATION_URL
settings.description: The transmitter's configuration metadata (its /.well-known/ssf-configuration); set, the receiver creates or finds its own stream there at start-up and keeps it in step with its settings

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host, set with OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_URL, or set with no token (OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TOKEN_ENDPOINT or, in development, OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_POLL_TOKEN): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A transmitter that cannot be reached or refuses: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_DEPENDENCY and retried; one whose issuer or stream audience is not the receiver's: SSF_RECEIVER is FAILED_CONFIG. An http URL under the production profile refuses SSF_RECEIVER: the receiver's token, and a push stream's endpoint token, would cross the network in clear; the transmitter's endpoints must then be https too (SSF 1.0 §7.1)

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_PUSH_ENDPOINT_URL
settings.description: Where the transmitter should push to - this receiver's public /ssf/receiver/events URL - for the stream the receiver manages; unset, the stream is a poll stream

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL with a host, or set without OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_TRANSMITTER_CONFIGURATION_URL: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The wrong URL: nothing arrives. An http URL under the production profile refuses SSF_RECEIVER: the transmitter would push SETs and present the receiver's endpoint token in clear

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_EVENTS_REQUESTED
settings.description: The event types the receiver's managed stream asks for, comma-separated; unset, the five its handlers act on (CAEP session-revoked, credential-change and device-compliance-change, RISC account-disabled and account-credential-change-required)

when_wrong.detail: Set to nothing but separators: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A type the transmitter does not deliver: it is left out of events_delivered and never arrives

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_POLL_MAX_EVENTS_CAP
settings.description: The most SETs one poll answer carries, whatever maxEvents the receiver asks for (RFC 8936 lets the transmitter return fewer, with moreAvailable)

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 to 1000: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_POLL_LONG_POLL_WAIT_SECONDS
settings.description: How long a poll with returnImmediately false (or absent, RFC 8936's default) is held when there is nothing to return; 0 answers at once

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 0 to 30: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_RECEIVER_SUBJECT_ISSUERS
settings.description: The issuers, besides the transmitter's own and this PingFederate's SSF issuer, whose iss_sub subjects name a user here (an identity provider the transmitter speaks for), comma-separated; an iss_sub from any other issuer maps to no one

when_wrong.detail: Set to nothing but separators: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. An issuer missing: SETs about its users are logged as unmapped and acted on by no handler

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_MAX_STREAMS_PER_CLIENT
settings.description: The most streams one receiver client may have at once; creating one more is refused with 409 Conflict, as SSF 1.0 answers a transmitter that allows a receiver no more streams

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 1 to 1000: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. Too low: a receiver that needs more streams is refused them

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_MIN_VERIFICATION_INTERVAL_SECONDS
settings.description: The min_verification_interval a new stream is given: a verification request on a stream sooner than this after its last one is answered 429 with Retry-After; 0 gives new streams none and never refuses

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 0 to 86400: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. 0: a receiver can have the transmitter sign verification events as fast as it asks

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
settings.description: The inactivity_timeout a new stream is given and reported; 0 gives new streams none. Recorded and reported only: this release does not pause or delete an inactive stream

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number from 0 to 31536000: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_LOCATION
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.truststore.location: the file of the CAs that sign the brokers' certificates, with SSL or SASL_SSL; unset, the JVM's own CAs

when_wrong.detail: Not a path: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A file that is missing or not a trust store Kafka can read: the Kafka producer is not built, an ERROR says why, and SSF runs without Kafka

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_PASSWORD
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.truststore.password

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is; wrong, the producer is not built, an ERROR says why, and SSF runs without Kafka

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_TRUSTSTORE_TYPE
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.truststore.type: JKS, PKCS12 or PEM; unset, Kafka's default (JKS)

when_wrong.detail: Anything but JKS, PKCS12 or PEM (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_LOCATION
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.keystore.location: the client certificate and key, for brokers that require mutual TLS; unset, none

when_wrong.detail: Not a path: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. A file that is missing or not a key store Kafka can read: the Kafka producer is not built, an ERROR says why, and SSF runs without Kafka

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.keystore.password

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is; wrong, the producer is not built, an ERROR says why, and SSF runs without Kafka

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_KEYSTORE_TYPE
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.keystore.type: JKS, PKCS12 or PEM; unset, Kafka's default (JKS)

when_wrong.detail: Anything but JKS, PKCS12 or PEM (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_KEY_PASSWORD
settings.description: Kafka's ssl.key.password: the private key's own password in the keystore

when_wrong.detail: Passed to Kafka as it is; wrong, the producer is not built, an ERROR says why, and SSF runs without Kafka

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_SSL_HOSTNAME_VERIFICATION
settings.description: Whether the broker's certificate is checked against its host name (Kafka's ssl.endpoint.identification.algorithm, https when true, empty when false); false only on a development rig

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true or false (in any case): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. The development profile reads a legacy spelling (yes, no, 1, 0, on, off) as false, with a warning naming the strict spelling; production refuses it. false under the production profile: SSF is REFUSED, by the start-up sweep whether Kafka is on or not, and by KafkaSetPublisher again when Kafka starts; under development the producer takes any certificate its truststore's CAs signed, with a WARN

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.description: Kafka's request.timeout.ms: how long the producer waits for a broker's answer to one request, 1000-60000

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or outside 1000-60000: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_DELIVERY_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.description: Kafka's delivery.timeout.ms: how long a SET may take to reach Kafka, retries included, before the send is reported failed, 1000-300000 and at least OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, outside 1000-300000, or less than OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS (Kafka's producer requires delivery.timeout.ms >= request.timeout.ms + linger.ms, and linger.ms is 0 here): SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_KAFKA_MAX_BLOCK_MS
settings.description: Kafka's max.block.ms: the longest a send blocks the thread that raised the event (a PingFederate request, or its audit logging) waiting for metadata or buffer space, 0-10000; Kafka's own default is a minute

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or outside 0-10000: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. Too short for the brokers: sends fail while metadata is fetched, and are logged

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_SECRET_KEY
settings.description: 32 bytes, base64 (openssl rand -base64 32): the AES-256-GCM key that encrypts a push stream's authorization_header in the SSF store; a value sealed under it carries its key id

when_wrong.detail: Not 32 bytes of base64: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting. Unset under the production profile with a JDBC or ldm store: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting (and counting the push headers the store already holds); under development headers are stored in clear, with a WARN. Changed without the old key in OIDF_SSF_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS: headers sealed under the old key stay sealed, an ERROR names its key id, and those streams' pushes are refused by their receivers

settings.name: OIDF_SSF_SECRET_KEY_PREVIOUS
settings.description: The key OIDF_SSF_SECRET_KEY replaced, during a rotation: headers sealed under it still open, and each is sealed under the new key on its stream's next write

when_wrong.detail: Not 32 bytes of base64, or set without OIDF_SSF_SECRET_KEY: SSF is FAILED_CONFIG and its endpoints answer 503, with an ERROR in server.log naming the setting
